page.overview:
Who is Dalimira?

Dalimira (also known as Dalka) was a princess of Redania, a daughter of King Vizimir II and Queen Hedwig of Malleore, and thus a sister to Radovid V and Milena.

Her father offered her hand in marriage to Foltest, but the young king of Temeria refused, making relations between the two countries rather cold.
